description: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 Flash reference-to-video model, a faster and lower-cost tier of Seedance 2.5 that generates up to 30 seconds of 480p or 720p video from reference images, videos, and audio, and can edit or extend a reference clip.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Omit or use -1 for a random seed.

audios.title: Audios
audios.description: The URLs of reference audio files to guide video generation. Up to 5 files; combined duration must not exceed 30 seconds.

images.title: Images
images.description: The URLs of reference images to guide video generation. Up to 10 images. Refer to them in the prompt as @Image1, @Image2, etc.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.default: Use Image1 as the visual reference and Video1 as the motion reference. Create a peaceful cinematic shoreline scene with rolling ocean waves at golden hour, soft foam, natural water movement, and no people.
examples: Use Image1 as the visual reference and Video1 as the motion reference. Create a peaceful cinematic shoreline scene with rolling ocean waves at golden hour, soft foam, natural water movement, and no people.
prompt.description: The text prompt to generate a video from.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: The URLs of reference videos to guide video generation. Up to 5 MP4 or MOV files; combined duration must not exceed 30 seconds.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Output duration in seconds (4-30), or `auto` to let the model pick a length from the prompt and inputs. `auto` is pre-authorized at 30 seconds and billed on the actual output length. When a reference video is edited or extended, use `auto` with `adaptive` aspect ratio so the output follows the source clip.

task_type.title: Task Type
task_type.description: `reference` generates a new video from the references, `edit` edits a reference video (replace subjects, add or remove objects, repaint), `extend` extends a reference video forward or backward, `auto` (or omitted) lets the model infer it from the prompt. `edit` and `extend` require at least one video; `edit` forces `adaptive` aspect ratio and `auto` duration, `extend` forces `adaptive` aspect ratio. Write the prompt to match, otherwise the task can fail with a task-type mismatch.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the video to generate.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to let the model choose from the prompt and reference inputs.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio (voice, SFX, BGM) for the video.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Seedance 2.5 Flash Reference to Video

Seedance 2.5 Flash reference-to-video is the faster, lower-cost tier of Seedance 2.5: combine up to 10 reference images, 5 reference videos, and 5 reference audio clips to lock a character, set, motion, or voice in a new 480p or 720p clip.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `images` | image URL[] (≤10) | — | Reference images, Image 1, Image 2, … |
| `videos` | video URL[] (≤5) | — | Reference clips, Video 1, Video 2, … Combined length up to 30 seconds. |
| `audios` | audio URL[] (≤5) | — | Reference audio, Audio 1, Audio 2, … Combined length up to 30 seconds. |
| `task_type` | `auto` / `reference` / `edit` / `extend` | `auto` | Reference sub-task; see below. |
| `duration` | `auto` / 4–30 | 5 | Output length in seconds (4–30), or `auto` to let the model choose. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:3` / `3:4` / `21:9` / `adaptive` | — | Output frame shape. Omit to let the model choose. |
| `resolution` | `480p` / `720p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native dialogue, music, and effects. Same price on or off. |
| `seed` | integer -1–4294967295 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes; `-1` is random. |

## Billing

Without reference videos you pay for output seconds: $0.12 at 480p, $0.24 at 720p. With reference videos, the input video seconds (at least 2) are added to the output length and billed at a lower rate: $0.075 at 480p, $0.15 at 720p. With `duration: "auto"` the quote assumes 30 seconds and the final charge uses the generated length.

| Output | 480p | 720p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s, images only | $0.60 | $1.20 |
| 10s, images only | $1.20 | $2.40 |
| 5s + 5s reference video | $0.75 | $1.50 |
| 10s + 10s reference video | $1.50 | $3.00 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Give each reference a role: “Image 1 is the dancer, Video 1 sets the choreography, Audio 1 is the music”.
- Numbering follows array order within each type.

## Limits

- Up to 10 images, 5 videos, and 5 audio clips per request.
- Reference video seconds count toward billing (minimum 2, up to 30).
- Output is 480p or 720p. For 1080p, draft mode, or more references, use `bytedance/seedance/2.5/reference-to-video`.

## Task types

`task_type` selects the reference sub-task: `reference` (new video guided by the references), `edit` (edit a reference video), `extend` (extend a reference video forward or backward), or `auto` (default, inferred from the prompt). `edit` and `extend` need at least one video and use the source clip's aspect ratio; `edit` also follows the source clip's length and is billed on the actual output length. If the prompt contradicts an explicit `task_type`, the task fails.

```json
{"prompt": "Replace the man in @Video1 with the character in @Image1.", "images": ["https://example.com/character.png"], "videos": ["https://example.com/source.mp4"], "task_type": "edit"}
```

## Also on SandBase

Other Seedance 2.5 endpoints and tiers: `bytedance/seedance/2.5/flash/text-to-video`, `bytedance/seedance/2.5/flash/image-to-video`, `bytedance/seedance/2.5/reference-to-video`, `bytedance/seedance/2.0/fast/reference-to-video`.
